live.instructions: Pinned U.S. state income, retirement-income, estate, inheritance tax, Medicaid-planning, and federal Roth transaction publications. Treat null, uncited, undated, pending-final, and not-applicable as distinct states; never convert them to zero. Retirement-income queries require one exact income type and never infer from a neighboring category. Roth transaction treatment is available for tax year 2026 only, separates federal taxability from Form 1099-R reporting, labels caller-provided inputs, preserves missing facts, verifies exact local TTA file and canonical digests, and never calculates final liability. Use get_reference_data_status for local dataset bindings, evidence age, and fail-closed future domains; evidence age is not proof that law remains current. Use dataset_info, retirement_income_dataset_info, estate_dataset_info, or medicaid_planning_dataset_info for dataset coverage and versions. compute_state_tax and analyze_state_tax_scenario cover state income tax only and run only when required rate inputs are substantiated. Scenario taxableIncome means caller-provided state taxable income after deductions and exclusions; planningContext is preserved as provenance but excluded from liability math. analyze_estate_tax_scenario computes only attorney-reviewed, primary-receipted schedules from exact caller-provided jurisdiction rate-table coordinates after applicable exclusions, deductions, exemptions, and excluded transfers; it never derives those coordinates from gross estate or gross inheritance, and unsupported credit, gifting, relationship, and deduction questions fail closed. Medicaid-planning tools are context-only, preserve every field status and source receipt unchanged, and fail closed when a requested evaluation date precedes publication or a cited fact's effective date. get_state_tax_history, get_state_retirement_income_history, and retirement-income treatments are context-only and never supply calculator inputs. Historical datasets are served only after an exact local digest binding; tools never fetch a live source during a request. This is reference data, not tax or legal advice.

tools.name: get_reference_data_status
tools.title: Get Reference Data Status
tools.description: Inspect local immutable dataset bindings, evidence age, calculation eligibility, and fail-closed future-domain availability without fetching the network.

tools.name: get_state_tax_profile
tools.title: Get State Tax Profile
tools.description: Return the pinned state income tax profile with receipts and per-field verification status.

tools.name: compute_state_tax
tools.title: Compute State Tax
tools.description: Compute tax from the shared exclusive-floor bracket engine when required inputs are substantiated.

tools.name: compare_states
tools.title: Compare States
tools.description: Compare state tax results for up to ten states, surfacing receipts and pending-final flags.

tools.name: analyze_state_tax_scenario
tools.title: Analyze State Tax Scenario
tools.description: Compare up to ten jurisdictions with deterministic bracket traces, effective rates, assumptions, and exact dataset/source receipts.

tools.name: get_state_tax_history
tools.title: Get State Tax History
tools.description: Return the partial, receipt-bound historical top-rate series for context only; never calculate liability from it.

tools.name: dataset_info
tools.title: Dataset Info
tools.description: Return dataset version, publication date, coverage counts, methodology, and citation.

tools.name: get_estate_tax_profile
tools.title: Get Estate Tax Profile
tools.description: Return a pinned estate and inheritance tax profile with field-level source receipts.

tools.name: compare_estate_tax
tools.title: Compare Estate Tax
tools.description: Compare pinned estate and inheritance tax profiles across up to ten jurisdictions. The dataset receipt appears once at the top level. A jurisdiction-level source, and jurisdiction-level supportingSources when present, apply to applicability and every field in that jurisdiction. Otherwise an entry (applicability or a field) without supportingSources is supported only by its own source.

tools.name: analyze_estate_tax_scenario
tools.title: Analyze Estate Tax Scenario
tools.description: Apply only attorney-reviewed, primary-receipted estate or inheritance schedules to exact caller-provided jurisdiction rate-table coordinates after applicable exclusions, deductions, and exemptions; gross inputs and unsupported regimes fail closed.

tools.name: estate_dataset_info
tools.title: Estate Dataset Info
tools.description: Return the estate dataset version, as-of range, and computed coverage counts.

tools.name: retirement_income_dataset_info
tools.title: Retirement-Income Dataset Info
tools.description: Return exact v1-v4 retirement-income dataset metadata, immutable digests, declared source readiness, effective fail-closed availability counts, and TTA citations.

tools.name: get_state_retirement_income_treatment
tools.title: Get State Retirement-Income Treatment
tools.description: Return one exact income-type treatment only when its local binding and source category pass; pending, null, or cross-category records fail closed, while audited sources without a published date remain explicitly undated.

tools.name: compare_state_retirement_income_versions
tools.title: Compare State Retirement-Income Versions
tools.description: Compare any earlier-to-later pair in the reviewed v1-v4 lineage for one state and exact income type with version and source provenance; unavailable sides stay explicitly unavailable.

tools.name: get_state_retirement_income_history
tools.title: Get State Retirement-Income History
tools.description: Return a bounded, chronological v1-v4 publication history for one state and exact income type, including digest-bound points and adjacent changes; unavailable points remain null and the result cannot drive liability calculations.

tools.name: compare_state_retirement_income_treatments
tools.title: Compare State Retirement-Income Treatments
tools.description: Compare one exact retirement-income category across two to ten states from one digest-bound publication; unavailable treatments remain null and the result never ranks states or calculates liability.

tools.name: get_medicaid_planning_profile
tools.title: Get Medicaid Planning Profile
tools.description: Return one digest-bound Medicaid eligibility, look-back, and estate-recovery profile with every source and verification status preserved.

tools.name: compare_medicaid_planning
tools.title: Compare Medicaid Planning
tools.description: Compare one Medicaid-planning family across up to ten jurisdictions without converting missing or non-final values to zero.

tools.name: medicaid_planning_dataset_info
tools.title: Medicaid Planning Dataset Info
tools.description: Return the Medicaid-planning dataset version, immutable receipts, and computed family and field-status coverage.

tools.name: get_roth_transaction_treatment
tools.title: Get Roth Transaction Treatment
tools.description: Classify one 2026 federal Roth transfer, rollover, conversion, or distribution from the exact digest-bound TTA publication, with separate taxability and Form 1099-R treatment, exact IRS receipts, and fail-closed missing facts; does not calculate final tax liability.

qualificationEvent.description: Caller-selected qualifying event. qualified_first_home is an affirmative attestation that the statutory buyer, qualified-acquisition-cost, and timing requirements are satisfied; the tool separately checks the supplied amount and lifetime-cap facts.

tools.name: compare_roth_transaction_treatments
tools.title: Compare Roth Transaction Treatments
tools.description: Compare two to eight independently resolved 2026 Roth transaction scenarios, highlighting federal taxability and reporting differences without ranking, recommendations, or liability calculations.

qualificationEvent.description: Caller-selected qualifying event. qualified_first_home is an affirmative attestation that the statutory buyer, qualified-acquisition-cost, and timing requirements are satisfied; the tool separately checks the supplied amount and lifetime-cap facts.

tools.name: roth_transaction_dataset_info
tools.title: Roth Transaction Dataset Info
tools.description: Return the exact 2026 federal Roth publication identity, supported transaction types, reporting-code rules, official receipts, and immutable digests.

tools.name: prepare_relocation_report
tools.title: Prepare Relocation Report
tools.description: Prepare a complete, five-section, source-receipted state-relocation analysis inline and return a jurisdiction-only AdvisorWorld forge link; creates no server-side record.
